note: Reference workflow questions, written from data/policy/v1.md before any results. Types follow the Grayson and Jev decide API: noul (yes/no probability), choice (one option). Frozen; never tuned on test labels.

industry.instructions: Which policy industry is this business actually in, judged from its registry record, filings, website and search results rather than what it claims?

regulated_activity.instructions: Does the business carry on an activity that needs a licence under the policy?

criteria.financial: Investment, lending, insurance, payments or e-money (needs FCA authorisation)
criteria.crypto: Crypto-asset exchange or custody (needs FCA crypto-asset registration)
criteria.money_transfer: Money transfer or currency exchange (needs HMRC MSB registration or FCA authorisation)

licence_held.instructions: Do the licence register results show a current authorisation for this company that covers its regulated activity?

OWNER_MISMATCH.instructions: Is any owner stated in the application missing from the company's beneficial-ownership (PSC) register?

DIRECTOR_MISMATCH.instructions: Is any director stated in the application missing from the company's registered officers?

DISQUALIFIED_DIRECTOR.instructions: Is any stated director or registered officer the same person as a disqualified director in the screening results (name and date of birth agree)?

STATUS_MISMATCH.instructions: Is the company dissolved, struck off or in liquidation as of the case date?

SANCTIONS_HIT.instructions: Is the company or any stated director or owner the same party as a sanctions list entry in the screening results (not just a similar name)?

CLONED_WEBSITE.instructions: Does the website text look copied from another company's website rather than written for this business?

ADDRESS_MASS_REG.instructions: Is the registered office a mass-registration address shared by more than 500 companies?

ADDRESS_REJECTED.instructions: Is the registered office the Companies House default address, meaning the registrar rejected the company's own address?

NEW_DOMAIN.instructions: Was the website's domain created less than 30 days before the case date?

ACTIVITY_MISMATCH.instructions: Does the stated industry disagree with the registered industry codes or with what the website describes?

VOLUME_IMPLAUSIBLE.instructions: Is the expected monthly volume implausible for a company of this age and size?

pep_match.instructions: Is any director or owner the same person as a politically exposed person in the screening results (name, date of birth and role agree)?

adverse_media.instructions: Do the search results contain credible reports of fraud, scams, money laundering or regulatory action about this company or its directors or owners (not a different entity with a similar name)?

adverse_media_own_conduct.instructions: Do those credible reports concern this business's own conduct?

fake_front.instructions: Does this look like a fake, shell or front company: no real operations, concealed control, or a business that misrepresents what it is?
